title: Swimming
description: Swim-only board: core.activity filtered to core.sport.discipline = 'swim' (sport_codes lap_swimming, open_water). No power/cadence/ascent at activity level for swim -- built on distance, pace and core.swim_length.

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

target.rawSql: SELECT n.local_date::timestamp AS time, n.note AS text, n.kind AS tags FROM core.note n WHERE n.athlete_id = $athlete_id ORDER BY n.local_date

panels.title: Weekly volume -- hours
panels.description: core.activity, swim sessions (core.sport.discipline = 'swim', is_parent = false), sum(duration_s)/3600 per ISO week (bar). duration_s is timer time, the volume column. Shown alongside the distance panel because hours and metres compress at very different scales on one axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.duration_s) / 3600.0 AS "Volume (hours)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly volume -- distance
panels.description: core.activity, swim sessions, sum(distance_m) per ISO week (bar), in metres -- swim volume in km would be unreadably small on a weekly grid. Companion panel to the hours view at left; kept as two panels rather than a dual axis for readability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.distance_m) AS "Distance (m)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pool vs open water -- weekly distance
panels.description: core.activity, weekly distance_m split by sport_code (lap_swimming vs open_water), stacked bars. Open-water pace and distance are GPS-derived and less reliable than pool lengths counted at the wall -- treat the open-water series as approximate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(CASE WHEN a.sport_code = 'lap_swimming' THEN a.distance_m ELSE 0 END) AS "Pool (m)", sum(CASE WHEN a.sport_code = 'open_water' THEN a.distance_m ELSE 0 END) AS "Open water (m)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pace per 100 m vs CSS (rest excluded)
panels.description: Average pace per 100 m of every swim in the period, against critical swim speed read from core.threshold. Computed from swim time, so the rest between sets does not inflate it -- that is what makes the number comparable to CSS, which is a speed while swimming. Values are seconds per 100 m so the series stays a number the chart can scale, formatted as hh:mm:ss for reading -- 00:01:40 is 1:40 /100 m. A lower point is a FASTER swim, so a dip is a good session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, a.swim_time_s / NULLIF(a.distance_m, 0) * 100.0 AS "Pace (min/100 m)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, 100.0 / NULLIF(t.css_m_s, 0) AS "CSS pace (min/100 m)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code CROSS JOIN core.threshold t WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) AND t.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND t.discipline = 'swim' AND upper_inf(t.validity) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Strokes per active length -- monthly
panels.description: core.swim_length joined to core.activity, avg(total_strokes) over length_type = 'active' rows, per calendar month. Restricted to sport_code = 'lap_swimming' (pool) because open water has no counted lengths. A creeping rise at constant pace points to technique or strength fade.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, avg(l.total_strokes) AS "Avg strokes / length" FROM core.swim_length l JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = l.activity_id WHERE l.length_type = 'active' AND a.sport_code = 'lap_swimming' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: SWOLF trend -- monthly
panels.description: SWOLF = seconds per length + strokes per length, computed per active length in core.swim_length as duration_s + total_strokes, averaged per calendar month. Restricted to sport_code = 'lap_swimming'. SWOLF is only comparable within a single pool length, and this schema does not record pool length -- read this as a within-athlete trend over time, never as an absolute number or a cross-pool comparison. Built despite that caveat because the trend direction is still informative; if the pool length changes across the dataset the trend would be misleading, but nothing in this schema flags that case.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, avg(l.duration_s + l.total_strokes) AS "SWOLF" FROM core.swim_length l JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = l.activity_id WHERE l.length_type = 'active' AND a.sport_code = 'lap_swimming' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stroke mix
panels.description: core.swim_length, count of active lengths (length_type = 'active') grouped by swim_stroke, time-range filtered. Idle lengths are excluded so the mix reflects actual swimming, not the roughly 157 idle/rest lengths that carry a NULL stroke.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(l.swim_stroke, 'unknown') AS "Stroke", count(*) AS "Lengths" FROM core.swim_length l JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = l.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE l.length_type = 'active' AND s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Weekly TSS
panels.description: Series A: mart.activity_wide.tss for swim sessions (joined to core.activity for athlete_id, discipline = 'swim', is_parent = false), summed per ISO week (bar). Swim TSS is computed via tss_method = 'swim_css' when a critical swim speed is available. Series B: count of swim sessions in that week with needs_manual_rpe = true, so a low TSS week caused by a missing RPE entry (rather than a genuinely light week) is visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(w.tss) AS "TSS" FROM mart.activity_wide w JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = w.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.needs_manual_rpe) AS "Sessions needing RPE" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Longest swim per week
panels.description: core.activity, max(distance_m) per ISO week among swim sessions (discipline = 'swim', is_parent = false), in metres. The endurance anchor -- tracks the longest continuous session each week regardless of total weekly volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, max(a.distance_m) AS "Longest swim (m)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent swims
panels.description: Every swim in the period, most recent first. Pace is computed from swim time, rest between sets excluded, and spelled the way the watch spells it -- minutes and seconds per 100 m. It is blank for a swim recorded without distance rather than shown as zero. Duration is the whole session including rest; the gap between the two columns is the recovery. Swim time source says whether swim time came from the length messages or from the session summary. Clicking a row opens the Session detail dashboard for that activity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(a.local_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", s.label AS "Sport", a.name AS "Name", a.duration_s AS "Duration", a.swim_time_s AS "Swim time", a.distance_m AS "Distance (m)", CASE WHEN pace.s_per_100m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (pace.s_per_100m / 60)::text || ':' || lpad((pace.s_per_100m % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "Pace (min/100 m)", w.tss AS "TSS", w.tss_method AS "TSS method", a.swim_time_source AS "Swim time source", a.activity_id::text AS "activity_id", (extract(epoch from a.start_time) * 1000)::bigint AS "start_ms", (extract(epoch from a.start_time + make_interval(secs => coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s))) * 1000)::bigint AS "end_ms" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code LEFT JOIN mart.activity_wide w ON w.activity_id = a.activity_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT round(a.swim_time_s * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.distance_m, 0))::int AS s_per_100m) pace WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY a.local_date DESC
